The form saves changes through the backend. A task cannot be saved with an empty title or with a due date earlier than its creation date. The user sees a success or error message after each save. The task list does not show changed values until the backend confirms the save.","business_value":"Users keep their task list accurate and up to date, and they do not have to delete and recreate a February and clicks save","then":"The task is not saved, the form shows a message that the due date cannot be earlier than the creation date, and the stored due date is unchanged"},{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form and the backend returns an error for the save request","when":"The user clicks save","then":"The task list shows the previous values of the task, an error message is displayed, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A task that no longer exists is open in the edit form","when":"The user saves changes to it","then":"The backend responds with a the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with an invalid input error, stores no changes, and returns the error to the frontend"},{"given":"An update request that omits the title","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with a missing mandatory field error and stores no changes"},{"given":"A save request that fails because of an internal server or database error","when":"The backend returns the error","then":"The backend stores no partial changes and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"A task row in the task
